title: Existing-Customer Rent Change Terms by Unit Class (Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement)
content:
Revenue management sets, per unit class of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement, the waits, the size limit and the notice period for existing-customer rent increases, and the terms on which part of a noticed increase may be given back.

## Increase terms

| Unit class | First increase notice possible after | Interval after the last rent change | Largest single increase | Written notice before the new rent applies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 6 calendar months | 11 calendar months | 15% | 30 calendar days |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 6 calendar months | 11 calendar months | 15% | 30 calendar days |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 6 calendar months | 11 calendar months | 12% | 30 calendar days |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 6 calendar months | 11 calendar months | 12% | 30 calendar days |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 9 calendar months | 12 calendar months | 9% | 45 calendar days |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 12 calendar months | 12 calendar months | 7% | 60 calendar days |

## Retention terms

| Unit class | Retention share of a noticed increase | Retention concessions per rolling 12 months | Request window after the increase notice date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 50% | 1 | 30 calendar days |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 50% | 1 | 30 calendar days |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 50% | 1 | 30 calendar days |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 50% | 1 | 30 calendar days |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 50% | 1 | 45 calendar days |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 50% | 1 | 60 calendar days |

## Definitions

- **First increase notice possible after** — calendar months after move-in before the first existing-customer rate increase notice may be sent.
- **Interval after the last rent change** — calendar months that must pass after the last rent change before another rate increase notice may be sent.
- **Largest single increase** — the class's largest single existing-customer rate increase, as a fraction of the current monthly rent.
- **Written notice** — calendar days of written notice before an increased rent takes effect.
- **Retention share** — the class's retention share: the share of a noticed increase the care center may give back as a retention concession.
- **Retention concessions per rolling 12 months** — retention concessions allowed per rental agreement in any rolling 365-day window.
- **Request window** — calendar days after the rate increase notice date within which the tenant may ask for a retention concession.

## Class comparisons

- The largest single increase falls as the class rises: 15% for both Standard classes, 12% for both climate classes below the suite, 9% for the Bluegate Premier Climate Suite and 7% for the Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault.
- In every class the request window is as long as the written notice period.
- The retention share is 50% and the allowance is one retention concession per rolling 12 months in every class.
